inputBoundaryInventory.summary: pyLoad's untrusted-input boundaries are (1) the Flask HTTP surface (route path variables, request.args/form/files/authorization, incl. an unrestricted dynamic getattr RPC dispatcher at /api/<func>), (2) the core Api methods those RPC/webui calls reach (package name -> folder, upload container filename, package data dict with _folder, config values incl. storage_folder), (3) remote/network content (downloaded file names, HTTP content-disposition, archive entry names, plugin-update payloads, torrent bencode names), and (4) the operator-level CLI. The filesystem-operation sink channels are the werkzeug/flask file-serving calls (send_from_directory, FileStorage.save), builtin/io open (download chunks, containers, config, logs, passwords, captcha, plugin data), os.makedirs (package destination folders), archive extractors (zipfile.extractall without pyload-side entry checks, tarfile behind a commonprefix guard, 7z/UnRAR subprocess), deletion/move/copy families, and the os.path.* propagation/validation chain (join/normpath/realpath/relpath/basename/commonprefix/isdir/isfile) that builds and checks the accessed paths.

extraction.metadataForm: Plain multi-column select queries WITHOUT @kind (a @kind problem query requires exactly 2 select columns and would break the candidate table; @kind table is not assumed to exist). columnContract: node - candidate AST node (location-backed, decodes as file:line:col)
callable - callable/member/field name, or the function name for parameter rows
receiver - syntactic receiver hint (base name of the object expression; enclosing class name for definition rows; '' if none)

moduleHint - dotted module path of the containing module (variable named moduleHint; 'module' is not a valid QL variable name), or literal module hints ('flask', 'flask.request', 'zipfile', 'tarfile', 'builtins', 'io', 'os', 'os.path', 'shutil', 'send2trash', 'subprocess', 'werkzeug.datastructures', 'flask_themes2', 'sys') for external/stdlib channels

arg_index - 0-based positional index carrying the value/path (-1 when the value is a return value, an attribute value, or a variadic/star-arg); parameter position in the definition (including the self slot) for definition rows
file - absolute path via the Location API (AstNode.getLocation().getFile().getAbsolutePath(); AstNode.getFile() does not exist)

match_kind - 'ast' (syntax-level match) for every family: flask/werkzeug/stdlib are not part of the database so no family resolves at API level; the column is kept for cross-project contract consistency

matchKindSemantics.api: resolved real API call via API graphs - expected to produce ZERO rows in this project (external libs not in the database; all channels matched syntactically)
matchKindSemantics.ast: syntax-level match on the qualifier/attribute/subscript shape - all emitted families
